basic_details.job_title: SGOU MDDC Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.application_mode: Online and Postal / In-person submission of hard copies

age_limit.details: Candidates must not be over 62 years of age as on 01/01/2025.

qualification.details: Previous experience in Editing and Reviewing in recognized national/international publications. Recognitions, awards, fellowships, and completed research projects in the field of knowledge.

selection_process: Applications submitted online and received in hard copy will be evaluated and considered based on eligibility. Candidates who previously applied under the 17.02.2026 notification need not apply again and their earlier applications will be considered
though they may update their qualifications if needed.
how_to_apply: Visit the official website at www.sgou.ac.in.
Submit the online application through the designated link before 5:00 PM on 11/11/2026.
Take a printout of the submitted application.
Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age, qualification, experience, research, and other relevant achievements.
Send the complete application to the Registrar, Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kuripuzha, Kollam - 691601 by post or in person so that it reaches on or before 18/11/2026 by 5:00 PM.
important_instructions: Candidates must be Indian citizens. Applications submitted online must be followed by hard copies with self-attested supporting documents sent by post or in person. Incomplete applications and those received late will be summarily rejected. Candidates who applied under the earlier 17.02.2026 notification need not re-apply; their previous applications remain valid for consideration. Applicants already who applied previously are permitted to update their qualifications if required.

content_sections.heading: SGOU MDDC Director Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the MDDC Director post.

content_sections.heading: SGOU MDDC Director Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Previous experience in Editing and Reviewing in recognized national/international publications. Recognitions, awards, fellowships, and completed research projects in the field of knowledge.

rows.qualification_required: Retired teachers from University/Govt. College/Aided College not below the rank of Associate Professor. Doctorate (Ph.D) degree from a recognized university. Not less than 10 contributions in the field of knowledge, including scientific books or publications in recognized peer-reviewed academic journals.

content_sections.heading: SGOU MDDC Director Age Limit
content_sections.text: Candidates must not be over 62 years of age as on 01/01/2025.

content_sections.heading: SGOU MDDC Director Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applications submitted online and received in hard copy will be evaluated and considered based on eligibility. Candidates who previously applied under the 17.02.2026 notification need not apply again and their earlier applications will be considered, though they may update their qualifications if needed.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for SGOU MDDC Director
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.sgou.ac.in. Submit the online application through the designated link before 5:00 PM on 11/11/2026. Take a printout of the submitted application. Attach self-attested copies of certificates proving age, qualification, experience, research, and other relevant achievements. Send the complete application to the Registrar, Sreenarayanaguru Open University, Kuripuzha, Kollam - 691601 by post or in person so that it reaches on or before 18/11/2026 by 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: SGOU MDDC Director Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates must be Indian citizens. Applications submitted online must be followed by hard copies with self-attested supporting documents sent by post or in person. Incomplete applications and those received late will be summarily rejected. Candidates who applied under the earlier 17.02.2026 notification need not re-apply; their previous applications remain valid for consideration. Applicants already who applied previously are permitted to update their qualifications if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is SGOU MDDC Director Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Sreenarayanaguru Open University has re-opened applications to appoint an MDDC Director on a contract basis for its Material Development and Distribution Centre.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for SGOU MDDC Director?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the MDDC Director post.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply online for SGOU MDDC Director?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 11/11/2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to submit hard copies of the application?
faq.answer: The last date to reach the hard copy of the application with self-attested documents at the university office is 18/11/2026 by 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required for SGOU MDDC Director?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired teachers not below the rank of Associate Professor from University/Govt. College/Aided College, holding a Ph.D. degree and having at least 10 publications or contributions in knowledge fields.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for SGOU MDDC Director?
faq.answer: Candidates must not exceed 62 years of age as on 01/01/2025.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for SGOU MDDC Director?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 63,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. Do candidates who applied under the earlier February 2026 notification need to apply again?
faq.answer: No, candidates who previously submitted applications do not need to apply again, though they may update their qualifications if required.
